faqs.a: AI-powered ambient documentation platform for mental health clinicians. Listens to therapy sessions and generates clinical notes automatically. Designed specifically for behavioral health workflows.

faqs.q: Is Sopris Health specifically for mental health?
faqs.a: Yes. Unlike general medical AI scribes, Sopris Health is built for therapy and psychiatry. It understands mental health terminology, treatment modalities, and documentation requirements specific to behavioral health.

faqs.q: How does Sopris Health work during sessions?
faqs.a: Ambient listening captures the conversation, then AI generates a structured note including presenting concerns, therapeutic interventions used, patient responses, and treatment progress. You review and edit before finalizing.

faqs.q: Does Sopris Health integrate with EHRs?
faqs.a: Yes. They offer integrations with major EHR systems. Contact them for specifics on your EHR compatibility.
Yes. HIPAA compliant with BAA available. Audio and transcripts are handled securely according to healthcare privacy standards.

faqs.q: How does Sopris Health compare to Upheal or Mentalyc?
faqs.a: All three are mental health-specific AI scribes. Compare based on your specific EHR integration needs, note template preferences, and pricing. Each has different strengths in how they structure clinical content.
